title: Email/Password Login Success
description: Verify users can login successfully using correct email and password credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter a valid registered email address.
Enter the correct password.
Click the login button.
Ensure that login is successful and user is redirected to the authorized dashboard based on their role.

title: Email/Password Login Failure with Incorrect Credentials
description: Ensure login attempt fails when user enters incorrect email or password.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter an invalid email or unregistered email.
Enter an incorrect password.
Click the login button.
Verify that login is rejected with an appropriate error message and no access is granted.

title: Role-based Access Control Enforcement
description: Ensure that protected routes are accessible only by users with correct roles (student, scholar, admin) and access is denied otherwise.

steps.description: Login as a student user.
Attempt to access scholar dashboard and admin pages.
Verify access to scholar and admin pages is denied or redirected.
Login as a scholar user.
Attempt to access admin pages.
Verify access to admin pages is denied or redirected.
Login as an admin user.
Verify access to all dashboards is granted.

title: Multi-step Ijazah Application Creation and Draft Saving
description: Verify students can create multi-step applications, progress through all steps, save drafts, and continue later without data loss.

steps.description: Login as a student user and navigate to New Ijazah Application page.
Fill in the first step with valid input data.
Navigate to the next step of the application.
Fill in subsequent steps with valid data.
Select the option to save draft and exit.
Logout and login again as the same student.
Access the draft application and verify all previously entered data is retained.
Confirm the draft application loads correctly and user can continue editing from the saved step.

title: Ijazah Application Input Validation
description: Validate that all form fields enforce required input formats and show correct validation errors for invalid or missing data in multi-step application.

steps.description: Start a new Ijazah application as student.
Leave mandatory fields empty and attempt to proceed to the next step.
Verify validation messages are displayed for each empty required field.
Enter invalid formats (e.g., incorrect date, invalid text characters) on input fields and try proceeding.
Confirm validation errors appear preventing progression until corrected.

title: Document Upload Validation in Application Form
description: Ensure uploaded supporting documents are properly validated for file type, size limits, and error messages are shown for invalid uploads.

steps.description: Begin Ijazah application and navigate to document upload step.
Attempt to upload unsupported file types (e.g., executables).
Verify upload is rejected with appropriate error message about invalid file type.
Attempt to upload files exceeding size limit.
Confirm upload is rejected with file size error.
Upload valid file types within size limits.
Confirm files are successfully accepted and shown in the form.

title: Scholar Dashboard Application Review and Certificate Issuance
description: Verify scholars can view assigned Ijazah applications, approve them, and issue certificates with correct data and formatting.

steps.description: Login as scholar and access the application review dashboard.
Select an application from the assigned list and review details.
Approve the application.
Issue a certificate for the approved application.
Verify that the certificate is generated with accurate scholar and student data.
Confirm the certificate includes an embedded QR code and downloadable PDF format.

title: Certificate Verification via Public Page
description: Ensure the public certificate verification page correctly validates certificate authenticity via QR code or certificate ID and logs verification attempts.

steps.description: Navigate to the certificate verification public page.
Scan a valid certificate QR code or enter a valid certificate ID.
Confirm that the certificate is verified successfully and detailed information is displayed.
Try scanning an invalid or revoked certificate QR code or entering invalid ID.
Verify an appropriate error message shows and certificate is not validated.
Verify that all verification attempts (valid and invalid) are logged correctly internally.

title: In-App Notification Delivery and Preferences
description: Validate that users receive real-time in-app notifications, bell icon updates, and users can configure notification preferences successfully.

steps.description: Login as any user and confirm notification bell icon shows unread notification count.
Trigger a notification event (e.g. application status change).
Verify notification appears instantly in notification center and bell icon updates.
Navigate to notification settings and toggle different notification preferences.
Confirm changes persist and reflect properly on subsequent notifications.

title: Email Notification Templates and Delivery
description: Ensure email notifications for system events (application updates, certificate issuance) are sent timely with correct templates and content.

steps.description: Trigger system event that generates an email notification (e.g. application approval).
Confirm that the respective email is sent to the user’s registered email address.
Verify the email content matches the designed template with correct dynamic data.

title: RTL Layout Support Consistency
description: Verify all pages and components render correctly in Arabic RTL mode without layout or typography issues.

steps.description: Switch application language to Arabic.
Navigate through core pages including dashboards, application forms, and public pages.
Ensure text alignment, component layout, and Arabic typography render correctly consistent with cultural conventions.
Verify no UI glitches, overlapping or misaligned elements occur.

title: Admin Dashboard User and Application Management
description: Validate that admin can view, filter, search, and manage users, scholars, applications, and certificates effectively with real-time data.

steps.description: Login as admin user and navigate to admin dashboard.
Access and filter the users, scholar, application, and certificate management sections.
Perform search queries and update user/application data.
Verify dashboard displays updated real-time data without performance lags.
Review audit logs for changes made.
Confirm audit logs accurately capture all management activities.

title: Performance Benchmark on Core Pages
description: Ensure core pages load in under 3 seconds and achieve Lighthouse scores above 90 for performance and accessibility.

steps.description: Use performance testing tools to measure page load times of landing, dashboard, application form, and certificate pages.
Confirm all page load times are under 3 seconds.
Run Lighthouse audit for these pages.
Verify Lighthouse scores are equal or above 90 for performance, accessibility, best practices, and SEO.

title: User Profile and Settings Update
description: Verify users can update their profiles, security settings, appearance preferences, and notification options successfully with correct persistence and validation.

steps.description: Login as any user and navigate to profile/settings dashboard.
Update profile fields (name, email, bio).
Change security settings (e.g. password update).
Adjust appearance preferences (light/dark mode).
Modify notification preferences.
Save changes and reload settings page.
Verify all changes persist and display correctly on reload.
